identity: Stocky broad-bellied bipedal stitched ogre zombie, muted gray-taupe/olive-brown skin with ochre round patches, pale beige highlights, and large jagged sutures held by dark ochre thornlike ties through small gray-tan metal loops. One large nearly bald head, small rounded pointed ears, an exposed SMALL tan-beige lobed brain at the TOP of the skull, two huge pale cream-yellow circular eyes with tiny black pupils, long flat upper lip, a few small square ivory teeth, ochre jagged seam on cheek. Normal face is slack dull stare with closed flat mouth; angry face slanted eyebrows and wide dark open mouth with square teeth; dead face blank pale round eyes and closed slack mouth, NO hanging tongue, X marks or blood. Heavy rounded torso and belly with pale stitched patches and ochre spots. Short torn cream-beige loincloth hem with ochre patches under belly. No necklace, skull ornaments, belt buckle, armor, tail or hair. Two muscular thick arms with very wide dark olive-brown wrist cuffs and large pale bare hands. Anatomical RIGHT hand grips ONE golden-brown wooden club with a thick knotted tapered head, ivory conical spikes and wrapped narrow handle. Anatomical LEFT hand is empty. Two short thick bare legs with ochre spots, a jagged suture and small rounded toes. Thick smooth dark brown outline, broad flat warm cel shading, matching exact original source.

equipment: one spiked wooden club in anatomical RIGHT hand
one broad dark cuff on each wrist
